artists.biography:
"Moulettes" are an English Folk Rock band. The band was formed in 2002 in Glastonbury by Hannah Miller (Songwriter, Vocals, Cello, Guitar), Dr. Ruth Skipper (Vocals, Bassoon, Auto-harp), Robert Skipper (later of The Holloways), Oliver Austin (Drums, Guitar, vocals) and Ted Dwane. The current line up is Hannah Miller, Ruth Skipper, Oliver Austin, Bassist Jim Mortimore (Arthur Brown, Chris Jagger) and Raevennan Husbandes (Guitar and Vocals). 
Moulettes are led by Female vocal harmony and Cello. The band is composed of multi-tasking, multi-instrumentalists who experiment with both electric and acoustic instruments, including deliberate distortion on the Bassoon and strings. The band often incorporate Orchestral and Progressive elements into their music and occasional play with a chamber orchestra. The band have received positive reviews from mainstream press which has acknowledged the bands original sound. The band have been nominated for several Best Of The Year lists and won Spiral Earth's Best Band and Album categories and won Fatea roots-music Best band of 2012. By exploring new blends of rock, pop, classical and folk music they have commanded respect by renowned players and DJs around the UK, including Bob Harris and Cerys Mathews.

perplexity.description:
Preternatural" is the fourth studio album by British collective Moulettes, released on 27 May 2016 through C.R.A.F.T Pop Records. The album blends elements of rock, pop, folk, and progressive styles, showcasing the group's signature use of rich vocal harmonies, intricate arrangements, and a diverse palette of instruments including strings, woodwinds, and unconventional percussion. Thematically, "Preternatural" explores the boundaries between the natural and the supernatural, with lyrics inspired by science, mythology, and the mysteries of the natural world. The result is a dynamic and imaginative sound that sits at the intersection of prog folk and art pop.

Within Moulettes' discography, "Preternatural" marks a continued evolution from their earlier roots-oriented work toward a more expansive and experimental approach. The album received positive critical attention for its inventive songwriting and genre-blurring style, with reviewers noting its ambition and the band's ability to balance complex arrangements with accessible melodies. While not a mainstream commercial breakthrough, "Preternatural" solidified Moulettes' reputation as innovative figures in the UK's alternative folk and progressive music scenes.
